title: Saint Pius V, Pope
short_summary: Saint Pius V is honored in the Dominican calendar as a Dominican friar who became pope and served the Church through reform, discipline, and fidelity to Catholic worship and doctrine.
key_facts: The Dominican Calendarium keeps Saint Pius V as a memorial on April 30.
The Order of Preachers identifies him as pope.
The Order's saints and blesseds page says Antonio Ghislieri was born at Bosco, near Alessandria in Italy, in 1504.
This memorial is shown as a Dominican proper observance and does not replace the general U.S. calendar day.

sections.heading: A Dominican pope
sections.body: Pius V's memory in the Dominican calendar reflects the Order's service to the wider Church. His vocation as a friar and his office as pope were both ordered toward fidelity to Christ.

sections.heading: Reform and worship
sections.body: His witness is best presented with sobriety: a pastor remembered for reform and Catholic worship, not as a figure reduced to political conflict.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Service of the Church
catholic_connection_sections.body: Pius V reminds the faithful that authority in the Church is ordered toward worship, doctrine, holiness, and pastoral care.
